name: workflow_final_cases_v3

model_policy.conservative_recovery: not used for the primary metric

scope: Unseen language/planning test with held-out source-selection paraphrases and matched no-load controls; existing ECG records are reused.
policy: The cases and labels are frozen before Workflow LoRA v2 training and before any model generation on final v3.
The test uses a third phrase family not copied from Workflow SFT v2 train or validation.
Every expected plan must execute successfully with the deterministic tools before freezing.
Run the unchanged base model and the new adapter once each with identical prompt and decoding settings.
The strict end-to-end metric is primary; recovery, if computed later, remains separate.
Do not tune from final v3 failures and report another run on this file as an unseen v3 result.
